messages:
Elena (Support): FYI customer hitting sudden 502/504 spikes on hosted inference API since ~11:30 PST. Reported after we pushed a small DNS zone update for edge-nodes. They see TLS handshake timeouts in client logs and intermittent upstream 502s. Provided a pcap + curl output.

Sam (SRE): Can you paste the curl output and the trace id? Also @Raj can you check resolver behavior for the affected region?

Elena (Support): Trace ids: trace=tr_0a1b2c3d, tr_0a1b2c3e. curl output snippet from customer:

```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate/
*   Trying 10.12.34.56...
* Connected to api.redwood-hosted.com (10.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake timeout
* Closing connection 0
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30001 milliseconds with 0 out of 0 bytes received
```

Maya (CS): Customer is on a latency-sensitive plan and this is impacting multiple users. They say errors started right after they saw a DNS TTL update on their side but we rolled a zone change too.

Raj (Netops): I see resolver churn from the edge in our logs during that window — several resolver rebinds + NX cache clears. Looks like the authoritative DNS side returned mixed A records across our rotation which caused out-of-sync edns0/EDNS client subnet behavior. That triggered a bunch of clients to hit nodes whose certs hadn't fully finished rotation, leading to handshake stalls.

Sam (SRE): Good theory. Any deploy-bot events around that time?

deploy-bot: cert-rotation job completed for edge-cluster-us-west at 2023-10-04T18:29:12Z (job id: cert-rot-8241)

Raj (Netops): Yep — cert rotation finished ~90s before the spike window. Combined with a short TTL on certain A records, some clients got the new IP but old SNI mapping. TLS SNI mismatch + SYN retransmits = handshake timeouts.

Elena (Support): Customer trace shows a mix of IPs in a 30s window: 10.12.34.56 and 10.12.78.90. They repro reliably when hammering with a tight retry loop. Quick repro steps I gave them:
1) run: `while true; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{remote_ip}\n" https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate; sleep 0.1; done`
2) watch for 502/000 (timeout) alternating with 200s

Maya (CS): They need a short-term mitigation while you investigate — suggested turning on regional fallback to a Dedicated endpoint or increasing client-side DNS cache to avoid switching mid-session.

Sam (SRE): For next actions:
- Raj: gather resolver logs and authoritative query history for the affected zone (timestamps 2023-10-04T18:28:00Z - 2023-10-04T18:40:00Z).
- I'll pull edge node TLS logs for handshake failures and correlate SNI vs cert serials.
- Elena: ask customer to temporarily pin to the older IP (if they can) or increase their DNS TTL to 60s and throttle retries.

Raj (Netops): Found a pattern — authoritative returned a subset of new pool IPs due to a partial rollout in our DNS service; that plus low TTL (10s) caused client resolver to flip between old/new IPs faster than cert rotation propagated to all nodes. I'll open an infra incident to pause the remainder of the rollout and force cache priming.

Sam (SRE): Can you also check whether our health-check proxies served a 503 during rotation? If health checks marked some nodes unhealthy temporarily, it could explain 502s at the gateway.

Raj (Netops): Health-checks looked OK overall, but proxies that rely on cached SNI->backend mapping did emit 502 when backend TLS failed to complete. I'm pushing a small change to extend the grace period for SNI mapping during rollouts.

Elena (Support): Customer accepted temp mitigation (fallback to Dedicated) and will pause heavy retries. They asked for a post-mortem once we have root cause.

Sam (SRE): Action owners: Raj (DNS rollback/pause) and Sam (TLS log correlation). Target TOC for customer PM: 2023-10-04T21:00Z.

Maya (CS): Thank you all. Please ping me when you have the post-mortem so I can coordinate customer comms. :+1:

Raj (Netops): Opening incident: INC-9921 — partial DNS rollout caused resolver rebind + cert race. I'll attach query logs and timeline shortly.

Elena (Support): Adding notes to the customer's ticket with repro steps and the temporary mitigations.

Sam (SRE): Quick note for runbook updates: add a pre-check to ensure certs rolled to all active IPs before DNS A-record swaps, and consider increasing TTL for blue/green switch windows.

Elena (Support): Great. Closing loop for now, will re-open if customer sees recurrence.
